## Two powerful tools. One smarter sales experience

SalesMail doesn't stop at outreach or analysis. Personalized Video helps your team build the relationship. Sidekick helps them understand and improve the moments that move it forward. Together, they create a connected sales experience from first inquiry to move-in.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6aa8493bf7a21f7e892ab18e_salesmail_logo_primary_standard.png)

### [personalized video](https://www.salesmail.com/personalized-video)

**_Make every follow-up feel personal._**

Build trust and stand out with short, personalized videos that make outreach more human, memorable, and effective.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69179b472998a7377e669565/6aa847ee6bf53ab53734c182_PV%20Home%20Page.png)
